task.summary: Compare all16 original Native cases against closed managed outcomes without changing assertions

selectionReason: Managed16b completed all16 originals with11 passes and5 stdout mismatches; prior positive-only workflow stopped before Native. Existing Native product and all reviewed295 compiler sources unchanged. This observation workflow records the full corresponding16 Native outcomes, including difficult cases, using original assertions and same180/3072 budgets. Only exact pairs that pass both original oracles can later receive goal credit. Keep failed parents and all originals; no C#/SLG implementation or oracle changes and no full-goal completion claim.

args: import json,hashlib,sys;from pathlib import Path;m=Path(sys.argv[1]);d=json.loads(m.read_bytes());a=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[2]).read_bytes());h=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper();assert d['status']=='failed' and d['attempted']==d['total']==16 and d['completed']==11 and len(d['failedCases'])==5 and d['inputsStable'] and d['processesStopped'];assert d['selectedCatalog']==a['selectedCatalog'];assert all(h(x['path'])==x['sha256']==h(x['originalPath']) for x in a['originalFiles']);rv=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[3]).read_bytes());assert len(rv['sourceHashes'])==295 and all(h(p)==v for p,v in rv['sourceHashes'].items());p=Path(sys.argv[4]);assert not p.exists();p.write_bytes((json.dumps(dict(status='source-compared-after-closed-managed-observations',managedAttempted=16,managedPassed=11,managedFailed=d['failedCases'],managedResult=dict(path=str(m),sha256=h(m)),selectedCatalog=a['selectedCatalog'],sourceHashes=rv['sourceHashes'],regressionCredit=0,purpose='Pair all original observations with unchanged Native product; no implementation promotion or changed oracle'),indent=2)+chr(10)).encode());print('MANAGED11_PASS_5_FAIL_CAPTURED_SOURCE295_COMPARED_BEFORE_NATIVE16')

args: import json,subprocess,sys;from pathlib import Path;args=json.loads(sys.argv[1]);out=Path(args[args.index('--output')+1]);assert not out.exists();p=subprocess.run(args,check=False);assert p.returncode in [0,1];d=json.loads((out/'result.json').read_bytes());assert d['attempted']==d['total']==16 and d['inputsStable'] and d['processesStopped'];assert len(d['cases'])==16 and all(x['status'] in ['passed','failed'] for x in d['cases']);assert (p.returncode==0)==(d['status']=='passed' and not d['failedCases']);assert (p.returncode==1)==(d['status']=='failed' and bool(d['failedCases']));print('NATIVE16_ORIGINAL_ASSERTIONS_OBSERVED_PASSES_NOT_INFERRED')

args: import json,sys;from pathlib import Path;m=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_bytes());n=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[2]).read_bytes());assert m['attempted']==n['attempted']==m['total']==n['total']==16 and n['inputsStable'] and n['processesStopped'];assert m['selectedCatalog']==n['selectedCatalog'];rows=[dict(id=a['id'],managed=a['status'],native=b['status']) for a,b in zip(m['cases'],n['cases'])];assert all(x['id']==y['id'] for x,y in zip(m['cases'],n['cases']));passed=[x['id'] for x in rows if x['managed']==x['native']=='passed'];p=Path(sys.argv[3]);assert not p.exists();p.write_bytes((json.dumps(dict(status='paired-observations-complete-not-all-tests-passed',originalCases=16,managedPassed=m['completed'],nativePassed=n['completed'],bothPassed=passed,unresolved=[x for x in rows if x['managed']!='passed' or x['native']!='passed'],originalSourceAndOracleEdits=False,records=[sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2]],claimsGoalComplete=False),indent=2)+chr(10)).encode());print(json.dumps(dict(bothPassed=len(passed),unresolved=16-len(passed))))
